fields.Name: T226 - Credentials Overview Computed Dashboard
fields.Description: Client-side computed dashboard (health score, category donut, per-type breakdown bars) built from in-memory aggregation of credentials/types/categories — not the generic entity grid every other entity reuses.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose 'Credentials'; it opens on the Overview section. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Verify the Overview renders its bespoke computed dashboard: a circular health-score ring showing a numeric score with a health label (Healthy / Needs Attention / Critical), a row of KPI cards (Total Credentials, Active, Types, Expiring Soon, Expired), and the 'Credentials by Category' donut panel plus a 'Top Credential Types' panel — each panel showing data or a valid empty state. Seeing these panels render is success; you do NOT need to interact with them.

judgeValidationCriteria: A circular health-score ring with a numeric score and a health label (Healthy/Needs Attention/Critical) is visible
A KPI card row shows labeled metrics such as Total Credentials, Active, Types, Expiring Soon, Expired
The 'Credentials by Category' donut panel and 'Top Credential Types' panel both render (with content or a valid empty state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
